author: mroguljic
body:
#### PR description:

Follow-up of #52013, which introduced the `SiPixelClusterShapeLimits` payload and `SiPixelClusterShapeLimitsRcd`.

`ClusterShapeHitFilterESProducer` now reads the pixel cluster shape limits from `SiPixelClusterShapeLimitsRcd` in GT instead of the `.par` files. This makes it possible to update the CSF limits through the GT, without a new release. 

The parameters `PixelShapeFile` and `PixelShapeFileL1` are removed; a new optional parameter `pixelShapeLimitsLabel` (default empty) selects the payload label. For HLT, `customizeHLTfor52289` removes the two parameters from the HLT menus. They will need to be removed from the menus in ConfDB.

No changes in the output are expected: the payloads in the GTs were written from the same `.par` files that are used today.

The PR must be tested together with the autoCond update to the new GTs (PR to be opened), since the current GTs do not contain the new record. The new GTs are listed [here](https://cms-talk.web.cern.ch/t/gts-for-the-new-sipixelclustershapelimitsrcd-record/149398/4).

#### PR validation:

- Same RAW input, `.par` files vs payloads: identical RECO output for Run 3 data, 2016 MC and Phase-2 MC, and identical HLT output for Phase-2 and Run 3.
- `runTheMatrix.py -l limited` with the tags injected via `--custom_conditions`: all workflows pass.
- Tested each new GT in a local autoCond with one workflow. Each of them passed.

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

To be backported to 20_0_X and 17_0_X.
title: Read ClusterShapeHitFilter pixel limits from GT
